en: A black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a crowd gathered on a snowy square in front of a large stone church with steep metal roof and small spires. People in winter clothing stand around market stalls, horse‑drawn carts and sleighs, suggesting a fair or market day. Bare trees surround the church. Handwritten-style white text along the bottom reads "Påsklördagsmarknad, Piteå Gamlestad".
